verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim point-in-time recovery to any moment, so an accidental table drop becomes a quick cleanup. They also describe a 'time travel' feature that restores the database to an earlier point, backed by automated daily backups and object-storage durability. That covers the restore half of the story. Nothing shows querying data as of a past point without restoring, and recovery appears to work at database level rather than per table. Missing for 10: as-of / historical-snapshot querying, table-granular restore of dropped or corrupted tables, detailed recovery docs (retention window, procedure), independent or hands-on corroboration.
